note: Mirrors GROUND_RULES in ground-rules.ts exactly. Never add values that the ground rules don't list.

rules.rule: Margins, paddings and gaps sit on the 8px base grid, or are one of the ground-rule values 4 (button text padding), 12 (labels, lists, button stacks), 20 (list padding) or 28 (sections).
A screen-level block is inset 24px from the screen edge, or is full-bleed (0) with its content inset 24px inside.
Space above a screen-level block is 0, 12 (label to content), 16 (inner spacing) or 28px (between sections).
Corner radii are 24 (containers, inputs, images), 8 or 12 (buttons, controls, banners), 4 (inner elements, static badges) or fully round (icon buttons, avatars, pills). Nothing else.
Text uses a type role: footnote 14, body 16, headline 18, title3 20, title2 22, display 24 (hero numbers), title1 28. 28 is the cap.
Regular, Medium and Semibold only; no bold.
Buttons and tappable controls are 44px tall (touch target).
A horizontal rail runs edge to edge: no outer margin, 24px inset as padding inside.
A docked bar over scrolling content sits on a progressive blur or a solid surface.
Photos, artwork, avatars and posters are one flat colour: no gradients, shapes or text recreating the image. Maps (abstract grid) and charts are not image placeholders.
